business.description: Getalong Enterprise Limited provides tax advisory, accounting, financial services, legal support, and business management consultancy as a one-stop solution for tax and business needs.

outlook.statement: Focus on strengthening core business, expanding customer base, pursuing carefully evaluated new opportunities and building a more sustainable and scalable business model.
The Management remains focused on rebuilding operating revenues and improving profitability through expansion of its service portfolio, technology adoption and wider customer outreach.

The Management remains cautiously optimistic about the long-term prospects of the Company. While FY 2025-26 witnessed a decline in revenue and profitability, the underlying opportunity in tax, compliance and allied professional services remains significant. Going forward, the Company will focus on strengthening its core tax solutions business, increasing technology adoption, expanding its customer base, improving operational efficiency and pursuing carefully evaluated diversification opportunities. The Management's objective is to create a sustainable and scalable business model and enhance long-term value for shareholders and other stakeholders.

key_audit_matters: Assessment of Trade Receivables: The company has trade receivables amounting to Rs. 29.02 Lakhs (i.e. 1.73% of total assets) at the Balance Sheet Date March 31, 2026. The increasing challenges over the economy and operating environment in the Trading & manufacturing industry during the year have increased the risks of default on receivables from the company's customers. Based on historical default rates and overall credit worthiness of customers, management believes that no impairment allowance is required in respect of outstanding trade receivables as on March 31, 2026.
